title: SQL For Analysis
description: SELECT as an analysis tool: grain, joins, aggregates, and parity with in-memory results.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can write a SELECT with a commented join condition and grain, save it as a file, and run it against a local database — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can add a GROUP BY whose non-aggregated SELECT columns are justified, match the metric to a pandas result, and state why a column is or is not in the SELECT list.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently write analysis queries whose grain matches the question, keep SQL and pandas parity on an agreed metric, and document the join that would explode.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a wrong total as a join or GROUP BY grain error, cite the duplicated key, and produce a query pair — broken and fixed — another analyst can run.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's SQL, name a GROUP BY that changes the grain or a metric that does not match pandas, and teach how to read grain from a SELECT on an unfamiliar schema.
